accepted_construction_rules: Build the can body as one continuous radial shell from profile/rim extrusions.
Place radial density at 16 segments for this scale and preserve quadrant symmetry.
Use wide spans for broad concave transitions and extra loops only where long quads visibly collapse under SubD.
Keep the lid, pull tab, and pin separate only because the real assembly and tutorial show distinct manufactured components.
Use connected quad topology within each component; holes in the tab are true openings, not stacked dark primitives.
